info.name: Lighter and Princess
info.plot: As soon as Zhu Yun started college life, the world was completely turned upside down by the intrusion of "bad boy" Li Xun. He was regarded by Zhu Yun as a rich, ignorant and incompetent son, but his real identity was actually a special admissions student who was admitted by the school, and a rare programming genius. After several confrontations, the two have some appreciation for each other. The senior Fang Zhijing made things difficult for Zhu Yun many times, Li Xun took action to protect Zhu Yun, and invited her to join the preparation team he set up to win a major programming competition on behalf of the school.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: After years abroad, Zhu Yun returns to her hometown filled with memories and old friends. Meanwhile, Li Xun tries to adapt to his post-prison life.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: An unexpected reunion sends Zhu Yun on a trip down memory lane, where a defiant classmate becomes a major headache during her freshman year.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun confronts Li Xun about his absence from class. Soon after, a computer virus from Li Xun causes chaos in his department.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun grows frustrated with Li Xun's defiant moves. At the school's talent show, her stand-up act is disrupted by a daring confession.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun and Gao Jianhong feel threatened as people flock to Li Xun's coding camp, and they decide to challenge him to prove their programming skills.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Before her abrupt departure from school, Ren Di shares a secret with Zhu Yun. Shortly after, Mr. Lin offers Zhu Yun some thought-provoking advice.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Gao Jianhong's ego grows as the team tries to secure a major project, but things don't go as planned. Soon, Zhu Yun has to face a harsh reality.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: The arrival of a condescending supervisor unsettles the coding camp members. Li Xun grows closer to Zhu Yun after they confide in each other.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: On a hiking trip, Li Xun, Zhu Yun and Gao Jianhong agree to form a trio to develop their own app. However, their efforts leave Zhang Xiaobei furious.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: A vengeful act from Zhang Xiaobei threatens Zhu Yun's future. Later, Li Xun decides to sacrifice their project to protect Zhu Yun.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun's mother asks her to stay away from a bad influence. After a volleyball class goes awry, a new admirer of Zhu Yun ignites jealousy in Li Xun.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: A new pursuer of Zhu Yun fuels Li Xun's competitiveness. Later, a meeting with Li Xun's sister gives Zhu Yun some insight into his past.

episodes.name: Episodio 13
episodes.plot: Dopo aver perso un oggetto caro, Li Xun si apre sul suo passato. Gao Jianhong, sentendosi escluso nel campo della programmazione, vuole intraprendere le proprie iniziative.

translations.value: Dopo aver perso un oggetto caro, Li Xun si apre sul suo passato. Gao Jianhong, sentendosi escluso nel campo della programmazione, vuole intraprendere le proprie iniziative.

episodes.name: Episodio 14
episodes.plot: As the holiday season approaches, Zhu Yun grows worried about Li Xun who falls ill. Later, they find a way to spend a special New Year's Eve together.

episodes.name: Episodio 15
episodes.plot: After an unexpected encounter, Zhu Yun tries to keep her distance from Tian Xiuzhu. Gao Jianhong becomes infatuated with a passionate fan.

episodes.name: Episodio 16
episodes.plot: A run-in with a condescending rival ignites Zhu Yun's competitive spirit. Another conflict breaks out between Li Xun and Gao Jianhong.

episodes.name: Episodio 17
episodes.plot: Gao Jianhong accidentally uncovers a scandalous secret. Soon after, Fang Zhijing has to face a bold public challenge from Li Xun.

episodes.name: Episodio 18
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun musters the courage to reveal her true feelings to Li Xun. Three years later, Li Xun presents Zhu Yun with a grand and unexpected surprise.

episodes.name: Episodio 19
episodes.plot: As graduation day nears, Zhu Yun and her friends begin to plan for their future. Meanwhile, Gao Jianhong stuns everyone with an unexpected decision.

episodes.name: Episodio 20
episodes.plot: While Gao Jianhong prepares to study abroad, he turns to Li Xun for a favor. Zhu Yun's career decision leads to a huge fallout with her parents.

episodes.name: Episodio 21
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun tries to console Li Xun after a devastating tragedy. Soon after, Li Xun meets with the Zhu family in hopes of gaining their blessings.

episodes.name: Episodio 22
episodes.plot: Il malinteso tra Li Xun e Zhu Yun si intensifica. Poco dopo, il discorso di accettazione del premio di Fang Zhijing si trasforma in una scena di caos.

translations.value: Il malinteso tra Li Xun e Zhu Yun si intensifica. Poco dopo, il discorso di accettazione del premio di Fang Zhijing si trasforma in una scena di caos.

episodes.name: Episodio 23
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun faces a cruel confession at a prison visit. As time goes by, Gao Jianhong reveals his true colors as he assumes control of Li Xun's company.

episodes.name: Episodio 24
episodes.plot: At an industry summit, Li Xun issues an ultimatum to Gao Jianhong. Later, Zhu Yun and Li Xun reunite as colleagues at another startup.

episodes.name: Episodio 25
episodes.plot: At their new company, Zhu Yun and Li Xun face a rocky start and a peculiar boss while the two try to save a doomed project.

episodes.name: Episodio 26
episodes.plot: An unexpected visitor shows up at Li Xun's place with a generous offer. Tian Xiuzhu’s close friendship with Zhu Yun leaves Li Xun bitter inside.

episodes.name: Episodio 27
episodes.plot: Out of his jealousy of Tian Xiuzhu, Li Xun hurts Zhu Yun once again. A medical emergency reveals Zhu Yun’s pain in the past three years.

episodes.name: Episodio 28
episodes.plot: Li Xun and Zhu Yun's new game is released to rave reviews, but its success ignites Gao Jianhong's envy. Hou Ning's efforts to help Li Xun backfire.

episodes.name: Episodio 29
episodes.plot: Zhu Yun and Li Xun's startup struggles against a massive ad campaign from a rival game. Dong Siyang takes his team to a retreat to boost morale.

episodes.name: Episodio 30
episodes.plot: Li Xun pours his passion into a new entrepreneurial endeavor. Meanwhile, Gao Jianhong launches an investigation into Hou Ning's past.

episodes.name: Episodio 31
episodes.plot: During the holiday season, a hacking incident leaves Zhu Yun and Li Xun scrambling to fix their game while Dong Siyang tries to track down the hacker.

episodes.name: Episodio 32
episodes.plot: Despite his past misconduct, Hou Ning finds a home and a new job. A revelation makes Ren Di realize the sacrifice her partner makes.

episodes.name: Episodio 33
episodes.plot: Gao Jianhong sends his wife to perform a despicable task. After an award ceremony, Xu Lina opens up to Li Xun about her life in the past few years.

episodes.name: Episodio 34
episodes.plot: Obsessed with winning, Gao Jianhong entangles himself in one crisis after another. Xu Lina tries to convince Li Xun and Zhu Yun to drop a big lawsuit.

episodes.name: Episodio 35
episodes.plot: Gao Jianhong hopes to leverage a sex scandal to win a legal battle. Later, Li Xun and Zhu Yun contemplate Gao Jianhong's sudden decline in health.

episodes.name: Episodio 36
episodes.plot: Gao Jianhong reveals his struggles over all these years. Accompanied by friends, Li Xun and Zhu Yun progress to the next phase of their lives.

translations.title: 点燃我，温暖你
translations.overview:
朱韵（张婧仪 饰）刚开始大学生活，就被“坏小子”李峋（陈飞宇 饰）的闯入彻底颠覆了世界。被朱韵当成不学无术富家子的他，真实身份竟是学校破格录取的特招生，难得一见的编程天才。两人在几次交锋后，对彼此都有些赏识。学长方志靖（崔雨鑫 饰）对朱韵多次刁难，李峋出手维护朱韵，还邀她加入了自己组建的备赛队伍，代表学校赢得了重大编程比赛。在相处中，两人之间逐渐萌生了爱情，并且不顾家庭的差异，勇敢地走到了一起。

两人情感日益升温，创业计划也接近成功之时，方志靖间接致使李峋姐姐出了车祸，李峋悲伤冲动之下打伤了方志靖被判入狱。面对出狱后再次陷入谷底的李峋，朱韵始终不离不弃，帮助李峋一路逆转，在商业竞争中狠狠击败了对手方志靖和高见鸿（赵志伟 饰），也收回了原本属于李峋的公司。最终，朱韵毫无保留的付出，让李峋终于跨越了家庭带来的伤痛，学会了敞开心扉，拥抱属于自己的爱。
